A long-standing hatchback icon on Indian roads, the Wagon R 1.0 is celebrated for its tall-boy design & unmatched cabin space, making it a top choice for families and city commuters alike. 

Not only can you explore from our own pre-inspected inventory of quality-checked vehicles in India, but you can also browse through trustworthy listings from verified dealers and individual sellers, allowing you to find the second hand Wagon R 1.0 model that fits exactly what you have in mind. 

Unable to find the right model for the Maruti Suzuki Wagon R 1.0 in your area? Browse through our other used Maruti Suzuki cars in various body types such as Hatchback, to find something that matches your needs for a confident purchase.

Why is the Maruti Suzuki Wagon R 1.0 a smart second-hand hatchback choice?

Since its debut in 1999, the Maruti Suzuki Wagon R 1.0 has remained one of India’s most popular and practical hatchbacks. With its tall-boy stance, spacious interiors, and fuel-efficient engines, it continues to be a top choice for city drivers and families. Whether you're looking for an affordable first-generation model or a newer variant with modern technology, the Wagon R 1.0 offers excellent resale value, low maintenance costs, and a hassle-free driving experience.

Practical and spacious design

The Wagon R 1.0’s boxy yet functional tall boy design allows for maximum cabin space, making it ideal for tall passengers and small families. The latest models feature a modern design with swept-back headlights, a bold grille, and vertical taillamps, enhancing its road presence while retaining its signature practicality.

Comfortable and feature-rich cabin

Inside, the Wagon R 1.0 is designed for comfort and convenience, with a high seating position for better visibility and ample legroom. Higher trims include a 7-inch touchscreen infotainment system, steering-mounted controls, dual gloveboxes, and power-adjustable ORVMs. The 60:40 split-folding rear seat in newer models ensures added flexibility for cargo space.

Efficient and reliable powertrains

The Wagon R 1.0 is powered by Maruti Suzuki’s proven 1.0L and 1.2L petrol engines, both offering excellent fuel economy and low running costs. It is available in manual and AMT (AGS) transmission options, ensuring smooth city driving. The factory-fitted CNG variant further enhances mileage while keeping emissions low, making it a cost-effective and eco-friendly choice.

Safety and durability

Built on the HEARTECT platform, the latest Wagon R 1.0 models offer improved crash protection and structural strength. Safety features after the second generation include dual airbags, ABS with EBD, rear parking sensors, and ISOFIX child seat mounts, but most of these features were available on higher trims. Its long-standing reputation for reliability ensures a hassle-free ownership experience for 2nd hand car buyers.

Second hand Maruti Suzuki Wagon R 1.0 variants

The Maruti Suzuki Wagon R 1.0 is available in multiple variants, catering to different budgets and driving preferences. Whether you're looking for a budget-friendly entry-level model or a premium trim with modern features, there’s a second-hand Wagon R 1.0 that suits your needs.

LXI – The entry-level variant

The base model comes with essential features like air conditioning, power steering, and front power windows. It is powered by a 1.0L petrol engine and is available with a 5-speed manual transmission, making it an affordable and fuel-efficient option for city driving.

VXI / VXI CNG – A well-equipped mid-range trim

This variant adds features like power windows, central locking, and a rear seat 60:40 split for better practicality. The VXI CNG model offers a factory-fitted CNG kit, making it a great choice for those looking for lower running costs and higher mileage.

ZXI / ZXI Plus – A feature-packed upgrade

These trims come with a 7-inch touchscreen infotainment system, steering-mounted controls, and keyless entry. The ZXI Plus adds alloy wheels, electrically adjustable ORVMs, and premium upholstery, making it a refined and comfortable option for urban commuters.

VXI AMT / ZXI AMT – Automatic convenience

For buyers looking for a hassle-free driving experience, the AMT (Auto Gear Shift) variants provide smooth and effortless city driving. These models retain all the comfort and convenience features of their manual counterparts, ensuring an easy and fuel-efficient ride.

CNG Variants – The most economical choice

The LXI CNG and VXI CNG trims offer a dual-fuel setup, providing exceptional fuel savings without compromising on power. These models are perfect for buyers looking for a budget-friendly and eco-conscious option.
